'''''Red Robed Wookiee''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] made sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was part of a series of five paintings, alongside ''[[Kashyyyk at Night]]'', ''[[Proud Wookiee]]'', ''[[Gift Giving Wookiees]]'', and ''[[Wookiee with Pups]]'', that were made for the festivities of [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]]. The painting in question depicted a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] wearing a Life [[Standard day/Legends|Day]] robe. It was supplied during the events of an annual Life Day celebration on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].

==Behind the scenes==
''Red Robed Wookiee'', alongside ''Kashyyyk at Night'', ''Proud Wookiee'', ''Gift Giving Wookiees'' and ''Wookiee with Pups'', were supplied during the 2006 Wookiee Life Day festivities.
